cc:Work.dc:title: Equal-energy demand schedules and outage outcomes
cc:Work.dc:description: Three synthetic 375 kWh schedules. Early peak: 81.1667 kWh unserved; late peak: zero; shifted peak: 11.7222 kWh. See the tutorial for exact values.
